pages.text: You might be able to train your Neollagers into more classes through the Ominous Pyre. Depending on the blocks around it, much like Dark Altars, a loyal Neollager will train into a specific subtype; each pyre can only train up to 8 at a time.

pages.title: Apprentice
pages.text: Requirements: $(li)Neollager $(li)4 Furnaces or Blast Furnaces $(li)2 Crafting Tables $(li)6 Barrels

pages.title: Gardener
pages.text: Requirements: $(li)Neollager $(li)4 Planters $(li)2 Brewing Stands $(li)4 Urns $(li)2 Composters

pages.title: Groom
pages.text: Requirements: $(li)Neollager $(li)12 Hay Bales $(li)12 Wooden Fences $(li)1 Horse Farm Register $(li)2 Barrels

pages.title: Fletcher
pages.text: Requirements: $(li)Neollager $(li)3 Fletching Tables $(li)6 Barrels $(li)2 Feather Blocks $(li)2 Flint Blocks $(li)2 Targets

pages.title: Artillery
pages.text: Requirements: $(li)Neollager $(li)2 Cannons $(li)16 Cannonballs $(li)12 Blackboards $(li)16 Iron Blocks $(li)8 Barrels $(li)32 Bricks $(li)32 Planks $(li)1 Pedestal holding a Bomb $(li)1 Pedestal holding a Fire Charge

pages.title: Grenadier
pages.text: Requirements: $(li)Neollager $(li)24 TNT $(li)8 Spring Launchers $(li)16 Barrels $(li)32 Bricks $(li)32 Planks $(li)2 Pedestals holding Bombs

pages.title: Conqueror
pages.text: Requirements: $(li)Neollager $(li)8 Anvils $(li)8 Smithing Tables $(li)4 Banners $(li)32 Wooden Fences $(li)2 Targets $(li)2 Redstone Lamps $(li)32 Bricks $(li)32 Planks $(li)1 Pedestal holding a Firework Rocket

pages.title: Apothecary
pages.text: Requirements: $(li)Neollager $(li)8 Brewing Stands $(li)32 Bookshelves $(li)8 Cauldrons $(li)1 Pedestal holding a Golden Apple
